test_sim_trajectory: test the habitat simulator trajectory by stepping through actions and validating agent positions and rotations
test_sim_no_sensors: test the habitat simulator initialization with no sensors configured in the agent config
test_sim_geodesic_distance: test the habitat simulator geodesic distance calculations for single and multi endpoint scenarios
init_sim: initialize a habitat simulator from a pointnav config yaml and return the sim instance
review_sim_apis: review the habitat simulator apis including reset, set_agent_state, get_agent_state, step, and geodesic_distance
